description: One wallet's demand history: the packets it voted for or against are listed free and keyless, its pledges are counted, and the pledge rows need your own signature. Use this when someone asks what they voted for, whether their vote is still active, or how many pledges they have made. To read the pledge rows, call again with the wallet, the nonce and the signature (the keyless reply ends with the message to sign). Votes and pledges are free, signed acts that move no money; a pledge here is a signed statement of intent only: pledged is not funded, nothing moves and nothing is held until a real payment settles through the separate funding door (prepare_funding). Read-only, and it records nothing about the caller. Cost and signer: free; the record is keyless, the pledge rows are read with a signature by the wallet's own with no gas, and the house never holds a key.

nonce.description: Only to read the pledge rows: the time in milliseconds from the message to sign, the same number the signature was made over.

signature.description: Only to read the pledge rows: the wallet's own signature of the message to sign the keyless reply gave. Free, no gas, used once.

wallet.description: The 0x… address that voted or pledged. The ADDRESS only, never a private key.

title: What one wallet has voted on and backed
